description: In front of you on the bed are a green plate and several toy sandwich pieces, including two slices of bread, bacon strips, a cheese square, a lettuce leaf, tomato and onion rings, a pink deli slice, and a yellow condiment shape. The right hand lifts a bread slice from the right and sets it onto the green plate, then adds bacon, while the left hand places the cheese and the right hand stacks on lettuce, tomato, and onion rings; next the left hand lays the pink deli slice and yellow topping on top, and the right hand reaches to pick up the remaining bread slice to close the sandwich.
